citations.narrative:
In the enclosure housing one red fox, the animal has excavated under the wire dig guard. This has led to gaps beneath
the wires which could allow the animal’s foot and leg to pass through and potentially become entrapped or broken.
Enclosures that are not kept in good repair can result in injury from entrapment. The facility must be constructed of such
material and of such strength as appropriate for the animals involved. The housing facilities shall be maintained in good
repair to protect the animals from injury and to contain the animals.
To be corrected by September 18, 2026.

citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
At the time of inspection, a written environment enhancement plan has not been established to promote the psychological
wellbeing of the birds.
Failure to establish and maintain a plan for environment enhancement can result in the behavioral, social, and
psychological needs of the birds not being met. The plan must address at a minimum social grouping, environment
enrichment, special considerations, restraint devices, and any birds that are exempted by the attending veterinarian
because of health issues or other conditions. The plan must be approved by the attending veterinarian. The facility must
establish and maintain an environment enhancement plan for the birds.
To be corrected by October 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
